structural_notes: Horizontal stacked bar chart. The bars are split vertically down the middle. The left side represents 'Not at all' and 'Not too' confidence (dissatisfaction), and the right side represents 'Somewhat' and 'Very' confidence (satisfaction). The left and right totals are displayed outside the bars. Internal numbers are shown only for the 'Not at all' and 'Very' segments. Colors range from light yellow (Not at all) to dark brown (Very). A vertical line separates the left and right halves of the bars.
